% Pattern: kind/section-title. An environment titled Conclusion is a summary
% unless a proof proves it; then it is a corollary. The second one has no
% proof and stays a section-like remark.
% Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=theorem-1
% want conclusion-1 statement/corollary 2 status=here
% want proof-2 proof - proves=conclusion-1
% want conclusion-2 other/section 3
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{conclusion}[theorem]{Conclusion}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}
A statement.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
A step.
\end{proof}
\begin{conclusion}
A consequence.
\end{conclusion}
\begin{proof}
It follows from the theorem.
\end{proof}
\begin{conclusion}
A summary of the section.
\end{conclusion}
\end{document}
